label: Limited-transaction account: daily limit for electronic banking
appliesTo: Accounts opened as limited-transaction accounts at ordinary banks, on internet and mobile banking transfers
why: The limit that actually binds, because a business pays through electronic banking rather than at a counter. It sits a third of the way down from the counter limit, which means the workaround for a single large payment is a trip to the branch — and that is the whole design.

history.source: Financial Services Commission — 2024 raise to limited-transaction account limits
history.note: ATM withdrawals run on their own separate daily limit at the same ₩1,000,000 level. Both were raised from May 2024 for ordinary banks; internet-only banks may set different figures. Lifting the restriction is a customer due diligence and transaction-purpose review, not a document that triggers it automatically.
